headword: {十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}

definitions.explanation: The first section of the small intestine, just beyond the stomach. It is the site of duodenal ulcers ({十二指腸潰瘍|じゅうにしちょうかいよう}).

examples.japanese: {胃|い}の{次|つぎ}が{十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}だ。
examples.english: After the stomach comes the duodenum.

examples.japanese: {十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}に{潰瘍|かいよう}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: An ulcer was found in the duodenum.

examples.japanese: {十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}は、{胃|い}から{送|おく}られてきた{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{腸|ちょう}で{消化|しょうか}する{最初|さいしょ}の{部分|ぶぶん}だ。
examples.english: The duodenum is the first part of the intestine that digests food sent from the stomach.

notes:
The first part of the small intestine, connecting the stomach to the rest of the intestines. The name literally means "twelve-finger intestine," a traditional reference to its length.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}{潰瘍|かいよう}: duodenal ulcer
- {胃|い}と{十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}: the stomach and duodenum
